scenes.text: Right now, a silent experiment is running that has lasted for nearly a hundred years, and nobody has ever actually seen its climax.
In 1927, a scientist poured pitch, a substance that feels rock-hard but is actually a super-slow-flowing liquid, into a funnel.
For a century, every single time a drop was about to fall, something went wrong.
Would you stare at this screen for years to witness history?
